Mission Statement 
The mission of the City Clerk's Office is to keep and to preserve the official public documents and records of the City of Manchester; to conduct and preserve the integrity of elections; to provide administrative and support services to the Legislative body and to meet other regulatory requirements established by law. 
For those applying for a marriage license or planning on getting married at City Hall, we kindly ask that you arrive between the hours are 8:30 a.m. and 3:00 p.m.   
The Genealogy Room 
The  Genealogy Room  of the Manchester City Archives is open only by appointment. Please call 603-624-6473 to schedule an appointment.
